title.narrative: Roma Women and Children Center Daje

description.narrative: The Roma center for women and children Daje specializes in providing support services to Roma women and girls who are at risk or exposed to gender-based violence or discrimination - SOS telephone consultations for women with experience of violence, legal information and individual consultations with women in the organization and in the field. Organizing workshops with women in Roma settlements on the topic of prevention and recognition of gender-based violence, these workshops have led to the establishment of new Roma women's associations. The grant will support the following specific priorities: - Training of eight Roma girls and boys for peer educators in the areas of gender equality, gender-based violence, reproductive health, mechanisms for exercising rights; - Conducting peer education in four schools in Belgrade; - Development of an educational platform for all participants in the project; - Final event.
